verdict.rationale: GitHub's Marketplace lists third-party CI/CD integrations, including Render's continuous integration and deploys and a cloud-based CI/CD service for mobile projects. The REST API is documented for building integrations and automating workflows, so a team can wire external pipelines to GitHub instead of using Actions. Missing for 10: documentation of the integration mechanics (webhooks, commit status/checks API reporting back to PRs), coverage of mainstream external CI servers beyond marketplace blurbs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running external CI in place of native pipelines.
